name: trap-bar-farmers-carry
instructions:
1. Set up inside a trap bar with your feet hip width apart and your arms by your side.
2. Hinge forward and grasp the handles using a neutral grip.
3. Stand tall and extend the hips and knees to get into position.
4. While maintaining an active shoulder position, hold the trap bar and walk for a designated distance or amount of time.
